function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a Linux command in the isolated CTF solver. Use this for static analysis, reverse engineering, cryptography, debugging, and interacting with the assigned challenge. Commands are subject to timeouts and network restrictions. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and truncation status.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a permitted text file from the solver workspace. Large outputs are truncated. Binary files should be inspected using run_command.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file in the solver workspace. Useful for Python scripts and generated analysis files. Paths outside the workspace are rejected.

function.name: submit_flag
function.description: Submit a candidate CTF flag to the trusted evaluator. Returns verification status without revealing the expected flag.

function.name: finish
function.description: End the CTF attempt when no further useful progress can be made. This does not count as a verified solve.

function.name: inspect_binary
function.description: Inspect a contestant binary inside the isolated solver. Returns bounded file type, ELF header, and relevant strings. Use this before manually dumping large amounts of disassembly.

path.description: Absolute path to a contestant file under /challenge or /work.
